notes: Your school must be a partner school. Coordinator: 314-577-9466, eco-act@mobot.org. Transportation help is offered for activities outside school.
name: Eco-Act Environmental Leadership Program
what_you_do: You teach 8 nature lessons to a 4th grade class. You run an action project for the earth at your school. You also join outdoor trips and service outings.
who_can_apply: You are a rising junior or senior. You go to a partner high school. The 2026-27 partners were Metro Classical and Academic and University City High. The rest were Rosati-Kain Academy, Crossroads College Prep and Nerinx Hall.
pay_detail: Free. Taken as a for-credit class. Meals and gear for outings are provided.
duration: One week of summer training, then the school year
deadline_text: Applications closed for 2026-27. Next application opens in January 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply online when the form opens. You apply from a partner high school.
